records.canonicalEnglish:
Narration: Sion and the others waited for Lucia in front of Dumna’s monument. How long had they been waiting?
Shoko: Oh! Is that...?!
Lucia: ...Sion...
Sion: ...Mom!
Lucia: I seem to have worried you.
Joe: Lucia! What in blazes happened?!
Sion: Mom, I...
Lucia: Sion. Everyone. Please stay calm and listen to what I have to tell you.
Lucia: That day—the day the meteor fell on Hom—I was entrusted with a mission.
Lucia: From that moment on, I was no longer Lucia. No, to be precise, I am still Lucia as well.
Welda: What does that mean...? What’s she talking about, Shoko?
Joe: We haven’t a clue what you mean. Tell us plainly.
Lucia: I arrived in the meteor that fell that day, fused with bacteria, the simplest level of consciousness...
Welda: Huh?
Lucia: In our universe, our kind are called Tiryut. We are beings of pure mental energy, without physical bodies.
Sion: Tiryut...
Lucia: Since the creation of the universe—perhaps even before it—there have been Ralua and Karma among the Tiryut.
Lucia: You can think of them as what this world calls good and evil.
Lucia: Both powers exist in this world by fusing with the minds of other species.
Welda: Hah! Ridiculous. So what did you come here for?
Lucia: I am Alshark, a warrior of Ralua.
Lucia: Karma is now leading this universe toward destruction.
Lucia: I came to warn you of the danger, and to defeat Karma with the secret power Wey Dumna must have left behind. Like me, he was a warrior of Ralua.
Welda: Wey Dumna, a warrior of Ralua? The Dumna who brought the people of Mars to this universe?
Welda: Pfft! Ha ha ha! That’s a good one!
Lucia: I understand why you find it hard to believe. But it is the truth.
Sion: Mom, I believe you. The way Uncle Mamon changed back then—it must have been...
Lucia: Has something happened to Dr. Penrose?
Shoko: Aunt Lucia... Dad and the others were captured by Zolias soldiers at the meteor’s crash site...
Lucia: Then what about Jido...? What happened to the expedition?
Unknown Voice: I had them killed.
Narration: The sudden voice startled Sion and the others. Without noticing, they had been surrounded by Mamon and Zolias soldiers disguised as outlaws.
Mamon: At last I’ve found you, Alshark. Or would you prefer Mrs. Asman?
Joe: Mamon! You bastard, what are you doing here?!
Lucia: Be careful, Joe. His mind has fused with Karma.
Sion: What are we supposed to do about that?!
Welda: Still spouting that nonsense? I’ll crush the lot of them!
Narration: Lucia stopped Welda as he started forward, then spoke in a low voice.
Lucia: Everyone, listen. We have no chance of winning if we fight them now.
Lucia: Leave this to me. On my signal, close your eyes and run back the way we came.
Welda: Hah! Ridiculous. I’m not going to...
Shoko: Welda, please! Do as Aunt Lucia says.
Welda: Tch! Suit yourselves!
Mamon: What are you discussing? Come along with me, now.
Lucia: All right. I’ll go with you. Just leave Sion and the others alone...
Mamon: Don’t be absurd. You’ve just told them everything, haven’t you?
Mamon: Now that they know our secret, I can hardly let them go.
Lucia: I see. Then you leave me no choice.
Narration: The next instant, Lucia threw something at Mamon.
Lucia: Now!
Narration: Sion and the others shut their eyes and ran. The object Lucia had thrown arced through the air, and Mamon shot it. A flash of light seared Mamon and his men’s eyes, making them realize it was a flash grenade. Yet even as he covered his eyes, Mamon remained eerily calm.
Mamon: Hmph, Alshark. I’ll let you think you’ve beaten me this time. But next time we meet, I’ll kill your friends before you can say a word!
Narration: Did his voice reach Sion and the others as they fled?

context.intent: As shown in connected canonical scene

records.canonicalEnglish:
Historian: Ah, yes! That’s the book. Now, let me tell you about the history of the Mars Federation.
Historian: As you know, the people of Mars are not native to this universe. They migrated here from another planet.
Historian: Their leader then, three hundred years ago, was none other than Wey Dumna.
Historian: As this book says, people today believe that he persecuted the Myuntos during the colonization.
Historian: But no one now knows that it was the first president, Kasta Baiya, who did those things in Dumna’s name after his death.
Historian: In fact, if you visit the Myuntos village on Stea, you’ll find that Wey Dumna is still honored as an eternal friend.
Historian: We mustn’t overlook the fact that Master Sartos, a Myuntos, was the only person Dumna could call a friend.
Historian: If you want to learn more about Dumna, visit the Myuntos village on Stea.
Historian: Ah, take this with you.
Narration: Received the Trefoil Emblem.
Historian: I’m sure it will be of some use. Whatever you do, don’t throw it away or break it.
